page.overview:
Who is Ambrosio Vento?

Ambrosio Vento was a Tilean merchant and slaver in possession of a magical talisman which the Skaven Siskritt desperately wanted to own. He was pushed out of a window by said rat man and killed in the process during the siege of Sartosa.

His fine Arabyan sword was not his only weapon, the talisman he carried, black inside with a platinum lattice and a long silver chain, was once propety of one of his slaves, is able to inspire courage in the wearer and deflect the killing blows of enemies, it was lost after the death of the merchant in an anonymous tavern of Sartosa.
